comment: Pinned firmware artifacts for the classic-ESP32 runtime tests (R1.5). Identity = sha256 of the 4 MiB flash image. Built reproducibly by runtime/provision/provision.sh from the pins in versions.env; a rebuild must reproduce these bytes exactly.

micropython.source: MicroPython ESP32_GENERIC v1.29.0 (e67ad6015a0a504c1fec9aa9bbf589d0432ed28e62546f4f8dd8a147f8bd95f6) at 0x1000 of a 4 MiB 0xff-filled image (provision.sh micropython)

TbiR1Scan.source: runtime/firmware/arduino/TbiR1Scan (provision.sh firmware, 2026-10-08, TBI_RUNTIME_HOME=~/tbi-s8-rt, same pinned toolchain). Sprint 11 R1 slice 6 matrix load. Note: on this host a rebuild does not reproduce the earlier pins byte for byte (already recorded in Sprint 7, s7-reproducibility.json); tests always use the pinned bytes by sha256.

TbiEdgeEcho.source: runtime/firmware/arduino/TbiEdgeEcho (provision.sh firmware TbiEdgeEcho, 2026-10-09, TBI_RUNTIME_HOME=~/tbi-s12-rt, same pinned toolchain). Sprint 12 bridge v2 scheduled-input test firmware.

TbiHcSr04.source: runtime/firmware/arduino/TbiHcSr04 (provision.sh firmware, 2026-10-09, TBI_RUNTIME_HOME=~/tbi-s12-rt, same pinned toolchain). Sprint 12 R2 HC-SR04 (pulseIn) runtime test firmware.

TbiDht22.source: runtime/firmware/arduino/TbiDht22 (provision.sh firmware, 2026-10-09, TBI_RUNTIME_HOME=~/tbi-s12-rt, same pinned toolchain). Sprint 12 R2 DHT22 (library-free read) runtime test firmware. Re-pinned 2026-10-10 (Sprint 12 Gate B, G-2, PM-accepted): the previous image embedded absolute host paths (symlinked arduino directory, fixed in provision.sh); these bytes are reproduced by five independent clean builds and reproduce the previous image's s12-determinism pins 10/10.

TbiLcd.source: runtime/firmware/arduino/TbiLcd (provision.sh firmware, 2026-10-09, TBI_RUNTIME_HOME=~/tbi-s12-rt, same pinned toolchain). Sprint 12 R3 I2C LCD (raw Wire) runtime test firmware. (G-2: the reproducible rebuild d8819c06… is NOT yet re-pinned: its equivalence held only under the Session Host publication defect fixed in 97de8e7; under the fixed host its stream differs and is under investigation.)

TbiI2cProbe.source: runtime/firmware/arduino/TbiI2cProbe (provision.sh firmware, 2026-10-09, TBI_RUNTIME_HOME=~/tbi-s12-rt, same pinned toolchain). Sprint 12 R3 Wire transfers (promoted from the feasibility probe) runtime test firmware.
